output.level_0: A bad model version corrupts the nightly forecast, and no one can revert to the previous stable build.
output.level_1: There is no way to undo a bad deployment, so a failed retrain keeps serving wrong numbers for days.
output.level_2: The team manually redeploys the last known good model version after noticing store managers complaining about errors.
output.level_3: The system automatically detects forecast degradation and rolls back to the previous validated model version within minutes.
output.level_4: Rollbacks are governed by strict audit logs, requiring finance sign off before reverting automated replenishment logic.
